sources.note: PICK-AND-PIN. LVEK accepts opening U+201E or U+201C in one text and names no closing mark, so a low-opening pair has no attested closer. The only complete pair attested is the VVC house style U+201C…U+201D (code points read from the PDF text layer of the handbook, HIGH); it is pinned, not claimed as the only legal Latvian form. « » is attested only through Blinkena (2009) p. 398, as quoted in handbook fn. 50; the book was not read. Secondary equals primary (p. 117: double marks for a quotation inside a quotation; single marks ‘’ only for cultivar names and glosses, p. 88). ACCEPTED COST of the identical pair: a nest whose inner mark touches the outer one is declined (quotes.md §6, §3.2 V1), pinned by fixtures. innerSpace none for both. punctuationPlacement none: placement depends on context (p. 117, p. 87). elisionIdioms and elisionClitics empty: apostrophe elision exists (p. 121) but no closed set. Handbook: https://vvc.gov.lv/lv/media/62/download (house style, SECONDARY). Retrieved 2026-11-14.

sources.cite: Valsts valodas centrs, LVEK, «Svarīgākie lēmumi 2014. gadā», 12.03.2014, prot. Nr. 33 2. §: valūtu nosaukumus, kodus un grafiskos simbolus «norādīt aiz summas ar saistīto atstarpi, piemēram: … 1 234 EUR; 5678,90 $»; Valsts valodas centrs, Tiesību aktu tulkošanas rokasgrāmata (2021; https://vvc.gov.lv/lv/media/62/download), p. 89 «Atstarpes»: «5 km, 25 t, 10 %, 21 €, –8 °C»; «dažos saīsinājumos (u. c., u. tml., š. g.)»; «starp saīsinājumu Nr., nr. un skaitli (Nr. 20, 155. nr.)»; «starp iniciāli un uzvārdu (J. Kalniņš)»; pp. 107–124 «… un iepriekšējo burtu vai ciparu atstarpi neliek»; p. 78 §7.1.13 (currency)
sources.note: Currency after the sum is NORMATIVE (LVEK 12.03.2014 prot. Nr. 33 2. §, restated in the handbook p. 78 §7.1.13); the rest is VVC house style, called «vēlams» and bounded by a warning against overuse (p. 89), SECONDARY. Handbook: https://vvc.gov.lv/lv/media/62/download. (1) beforePunctuation and narrowBeforePunctuation empty: a stated negative, «… un iepriekšējo burtu vai ciparu atstarpi neliek» for . , : ; ? ! and the apostrophe (pp. 107–124). (2) spacedUnits: % and km and °C from p. 89 (and p. 88 «15 %»), € from pp. 78 and 89, EUR from LVEK («1 234 EUR») and p. 78. Not listed though attested, by DECISION: $ (LVEK «5678,90 $»), £, ¥, USD, GBP (p. 78) and °F (fn. 54); no closed set is stated. Single-letter t, m and g are excluded by DECISION although «25 t» is attested on p. 89: they are also common words. kg and cm are not listed because no read source spaces them. A bare ° is closed up (fn. 54) and not listed; closedUnits is empty. (3) abbreviations = u. c., u. tml., š. g. (p. 89). (4) beforeNumber = Nr. only (p. 89 «Nr. 20», p. 88, p. 119); lowercase «nr.» is attested only after the number («155. nr.»), which N5 cannot express, so it is not listed. (5) initialBinding = single: LVEK 10.09.2014 prot. Nr. 36 5. § («pēc datuma un iniciāļa norādes lietojama saistītā atstarpe») and p. 89 («starp iniciāli un uzvārdu (J. Kalniņš)») state the rule for one initial, so «chain» would leave the cited rule unmet. ACCEPTED COST, as in fr, cs and ro: a lone capital before a full stop is read as an initial even at a sentence boundary (nbsp.md §3.9, §7.9a). (6) afterShortWords, beforeUnits, beforeWord and afterSymbols empty: no source binds un, ar, uz or no, and § is written after its number («3. §», p. 85). Not expressible and so not covered: binding after a dotted ordinal («2018. gada», «4. stāvs», «155. nr.», p. 89), after a date (LVEK), and inside digit groups («10 000»). Retrieved 2026-11-14.
